title: Scaling Relations Associated with Millimeter Continuum Sizes in Protoplanetary Disks
question: How do mm continuum sizes and luminosities of protoplanetary disks scale with each other and with stellar host mass, luminosity and accretion rate, and what do these relations imply?

data.bands: Band 7 (mean 335 GHz, 895 um) for the Lupus survey

evidence.quote: For the SMA sample, we adopted the parameters inferred by (cite: tripathi17)

what.value: Teff, L*, Lacc for Lupus targets

evidence.quote: In their Table A.2, (cite: alcala17) list effective temperatures ($T_{\rm eff}$) and stellar luminosities ($L_\ast$)

what.value: Gaia DR2 parallaxes and 30 uas zero-point shift

evidence.quote: we corrected the catalog parallaxes for the known 30 $\mu$as systematic shift with respect to the quasar reference frame

recipe.goal: Assemble and prepare ALMA continuum visibilities
recipe.method: Use archival pipeline-calibrated Band 7 data, drop line windows, average to pseudo-channels, phase-only self-cal for bright targets

recipe.goal: Fit visibility models to derive F_nu, R_eff, L_mm
recipe.method: Gaussian likelihood comparing observed visibilities with Hankel transforms of Nuker profiles with 9 parameters; effective radius encloses 68% of flux
assumptions: Distances from Gaia DR2 with uniform d prior

recipe.goal: Derive stellar masses, ages, accretion rates
recipe.method: Convert Teff and L* to log posteriors rescaled to adopted d; sample M*, age from MIST tracks; Lacc log-normal with 0.25 dex
Linear regression in log space with intrinsic scatter, errors and censoring, via linmix
assumptions: 2D posteriors approximated as symmetric elliptical Gaussians

recipe.goal: Interpret with optically thick and thin population models
recipe.method: Analytic power-law Td and tau profiles with outer radius R_o, manually tuned population models
key_parameters: T0 = 30 K at r0 = 10 au for L*=Lsun
assumptions: Distinct outer boundary R_o; Td ∝ L*^0.25 r^-q

evidence.quote: The permissible range of $\mathcal{F}$ is $\sim$0.1–0.5 before the model scatter becomes considerably broader than is observed.
the transition disks alone have a much lower scaling index ($\mathcal{B} = 0.86\pm0.18$; a difference at the 3 $\sigma$ level)
The median $T_b$ at 40 au is $\sim$5 K, with a standard deviation of only a factor of two

not_stated_but_needed: Exact prior ranges for the Nuker parameters (deferred to Tripathi et al. 2017)
Visibility weighting/binning and any uv-range cuts used in the MCMC
emcee walkers, steps, burn-in and convergence criteria
Line-free channels used for continuum visibilities
Treatment of ALMA flux scale beyond the 10% factor
Details of the manual tuning of the thick/thin population models
Visibility data set preparation for multiple-pointing targets beyond CLEAN-component subtraction
missing_for_reproduction: Tripathi et al. 2017 prior definitions and code
score_reason: Data public and method clearly described but relies on Tripathi 2017 for priors and details; no code released.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric regression results, but recipe depends on cited earlier paper.
